notes.title: New Update for Eo - Explore, Engage, and Experience Like Never Before!
notes.content:
Greetings, Adventurers!
We’re thrilled to announce a massive update to Eo, bringing a whole new level of depth and adventure to your experience. Delve into our latest features and prepare for an epic journey!

- Explore New Territories
Venture into the unknown with an additional 5 km of richly detailed map. Discover new quests, secrets, and challenges in these uncharted lands.

- The Corruption of Maeve Campaign
Starting September 20th, join the new campaign "The Corruption of Maeve." Unravel the mysteries of Maeve's transformation and fight against a corruption that threatens the very essence of Eo. This campaign is set to bring new storylines, characters, and dynamic content that will change the way you play. This campaign was triggered by the player Atis, currently King of the Ravens.

- Custom Content from Our Community
We’ve listened to your stories and incorporated content directly from the player bios you shared on our Discord. Look for elements you and your fellow players created in the world of Eo, bringing our community's creativity to life.

- Join Us!
This update is just the beginning. We invite you to join us in this ever-evolving world, where your actions and stories shape the future of Eo. Check out the new content, share your experiences, and continue to write your legend.

Prepare your gear, gather your allies, and explore the expanded world of Eo. We can't wait to see where your adventures take you next!

Join Our Discord: https://discord.gg/nhzzGE3e6y
Visit Our Website: http://www.eogame.com
Happy Adventuring,

The Eo Development Team

notes.title: January Hotfix #19.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have a new hotfix for you, taking care of several crashes, bugs, and more!

We're adding campaigns related to each of the gods. Now, when you choose your god, you're also choosing your Main Campaign on Eo, so choose well. Each religious campaign is also connected to the god's place in the world, or how to make the god stronger. If you're not religious, just don't follow the objectives in this campaign. We also took care of several issues reported by players.

As ever, thank you to everyone who took the time to report these issues to us.

CRASHES AND BLOCKERS
Fixed a crash that would occur when attacking while swimming.
Fixed a crash that would occur when swimming too far away.

MULTIPLAYER
Dialogues are not closing now when other players open their dialogue box.

GAMEPLAY
New religious campaigns now in the Quest Panel (press O).
Fixed projectiles without gravity.
Rebalanced the Crocodile to be stronger and Wolf to be weaker.

notes.title: The New Eo
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/h1] 
after our first roleplay sessions, we understood that the main concerns were:
1- connection problems
2- movement and combat
3- inventory and saved characters issues
4- level up system
5- magic system

1- So, to address this, we changed from Photon Fusion to Photon PUN (a more reliable and stable networking solution). We've been playing for the last 2 months and we feel all the connectivity issues are in the past now. So, moving forward.
2- We implemented Opsive's Ultimate Character Controller and it's looking awesome. We had to tweak a bit to create a Flying Ability (important to us or our dear Ravenfolk and Fey would be grounded)
3- a lot of players were having problems with inventory and characters losing their data. We took some time off to find these problems and address them. They were being caused by our DM Client overriding player's data, now it's in the past.
4- A lot of you were asking for a level up system, but our level will be in your skills. So, we understand everyone wants to see the little "what's my level" up there, but look at your skills now. Train the skills you want to level up and their level will increase their use.
5- Magic in Eo is as before, but we improved the system to make it more.. explicit than before. You still need to figure out how to use magic, since it's a matter of knowledge in this world. Some people understand exactly what you need to push to cast a Fireball, others have no idea. So, if you're the second case, you need to find magic books that will explain it or maybe a tutor that knows how to cast spells. In time, with more players, maybe someone will even open a Magic School to teach people. We'll see. All the magic in Eo can be seen in your skills, since magic is also considered a skill here. The more skill points you have, more spells you'll be able to use.

notes.title: Stop and Breathe a Little
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680267/2cec48460ca3c3ad0c286d22ee7ccd42ce02b33a.png[/img]
Hello everyone, here's some things you've saying about Eo:

- Long load time
- Connection issues / lag
- Characters too slow
- No sound control / settings
- Areas too small

So, after gathering all the feedback, it's time to take a step back and re-start fresh. We're gathering everyone in the studio (that means 2 devs, 2 modelers and 1 illustrator) and we will tackle all the feedback we got from you guys. Focus on the negative reviews and what's wrong with the game. We'll take November and December to work on a massive overhaul and come up with something that will make all those negative reviews make no sense (we hope). 

So, let's hear what else you think should change about Eo to make it an amazing place for us roleplayers.

Here's some other issues we'll look into:

- Can't spawn too many animals, bad AI code, game lags.
- Hunting is not ok, skinning is terrible
- There's no indication of what you can gather (should be or not?)

To give everyone else a roleplay update about what happened when Eo was born:

- Redwood changed its name to Darkwood, the forest has been corrupted by Maeve and her followers, a temple was built to the goddess. Maeve created aberrations that make the forest a big threat.

- Luktharus found the corpse of a dead god, Lucifer. He formed a group called the Dark Monastery and is still trying to raise the god from the dead. Lucifer was killed by Eo when he tried to destroy humans and elves.

So, let's get ready to fix.

Write here what you think has to change to make this an alpha early access.

- Hunting is not ok, skinning is terrible
- There's no indication of what you can gather (should be or not?)

notes.title: Performance Update and Mountains Pass Inn
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680267/4fa33b5a908f7d612c0a5a4509fb90291edaca2e.png[/img]

The Mountains Pass Inn grows more each day. Its owner built a tanner and he has been seen working on leather armor. The fey have been whispering of a Dark Monastery (a group of men and demon working together), but nobody knows who they are or their plans.

We have been working tiredlessly to make everything perfect for everyone, adjusting movement synch (which was causing a clunky game), improving performance (some people were trying to sound smart by saying we don't have LODs or impostors, which you can clearly see in the game, so boo to them). We found this problem, found other problems and we keep finding problems every day. In spite of some shots that were taken, saying our player base is just family and friends (which is not far from the truth), our decision to release early stands. We play, we have fun with friends, amazing roleplaying has been going on and these negative reviews only make us stronger (which is also great). 

We are a small team with zero budget and zero funding, but we do have a dream - to make an awesome rpg where you can roleplay your character and change the world. Thank you all for making this dream come true!

notes.content:
Hello everyone, our devs are still trying to improve optimization and performance without losing any of our beautiful shadows and reflections. 

We want to thank everyone that played the game, even those that made negative reviews and made our devs cry, because that made they work even harder to make the game better for you <3

notes.title: Hotfix #01
notes.content:
- Press any key (for players that didn't realize the game wasn't loading)
- Fixed issues with mesh baking
- Double check LODs (all good here)
- Double check imposters (all good here)

Thanks for all rpg lovers playing with us, means a lot. We appreciate the feedback, but also ask to understand we are not Larian or CdProjekt and we don't have 10 million dollars and a team of algorithm programmers optimizing. We are a team of 3 programmers struggling on zero budget. It's not an excuse, we ask a bit of patience. It will get better, and you all are helping us get there.

We also understand the concept is new to some people that just want to hop around killing things, in this case, maybe the game isn't for you really. The game is a slow paced, social experience, not supposed to be focused in combat (our combat system is absurdly simple: Ctrl, Raycast, Hit). But in time, even people that don't roleplay will feel attracted to it and we hope to convert a lot of people into roleplaying.
